name: Us Are Toys [CHAPTER 2]
desc:
Credit to 'The Walten Files' for 'Billy The Rabbit' (If the creator of The Walten Files wants 'Billy The Rabbit' to be removed, he will be!)

Us Are Toys is a MULTIPLAYER HORROR GAME which tells a story about a field trip to a toy factory. Fun Factory has invited you to come visit and take a tour of the factory. However, things start to take a very dark turn.

WARNING: This game contains disturbing images, sudden loud noises, jumpscares, play at your own risk!
